sentences: Unit-cost tree edit distance counts node insertions, deletions, and relabelings needed to transform one rooted tree into another.
Weighted versions have conditional hardness barriers that do not immediately carry over when every operation costs one.
The source asks for either a subcubic algorithm or an appropriate conditional lower bound for the unweighted problem.
Small-distance algorithms give another route to exploiting structure.
The project aims to decide whether uniform edit costs remove a genuine computational obstacle or merely defeat existing reductions.
